parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/RequestLineAuthFeatureTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.8888), the two methods — `returnsFalseWhenFlagDisabled` (line 25) and `returnsFalseWhenFlagNotSet` (line 55) — are distinct test cases exercising different flag states ('disabled' vs 'not set'), which are semantically separate conditions even if their structure is nearly identical. Merging or extracting them would obscure the intent of each test scenario and couple test-fixture code in a way that reduces diagnostic clarity when a single case fails.
